changes.content:
# Local development only; not a production deployment image.
FROM node:20.9
WORKDIR /app
ENV NODE_ENV=development
ENV NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1
COPY package.json package-lock.json ./
RUN npm ci --include=dev --no-audit --no-fund
COPY . .
EXPOSE 3000
CMD ["npm", "run", "dev"]
changes.reason: Use Node 20.9 inferred from repository requirements, install the reviewed npm lockfile with npm ci, and run the declared dev script.
changes.diff:
--- /dev/null
+++ b/Dockerfile
@@ -0,0 +1,10 @@

+FROM node:20.9
+WORKDIR /app
+ENV NODE_ENV=development
+ENV NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1
+COPY package.json package-lock.json ./
+RUN npm ci --include=dev --no-audit --no-fund
+COPY . .
+EXPOSE 3000
+CMD ["npm", "run", "dev"]
